quests.name: Dawn's Gambit
quests.objective: Place Dawn's Gambit in the Viewing Room of the Scholomance. Defeat Vectus, then return to Betina Bigglezink.
quests.description: Use Dawn's Gambit in the Viewing Room and defeat Vectus.

quests.name: Barov Family Fortune
quests.objective: Venture to the Scholomance and recover the Barov family fortune. Four deeds make up this fortune: The Deed to Caer Darrow; The Deed to Brill; The Deed to Tarren Mill; and The Deed to Southshore. Return to Alexi Barov when you have completed this task.
quests.description: The four deeds: Southshore in the first large chamber, Tarren Mill before the hatchlings, Brill by Ras Frostwhisper, Caer Darrow by Lord Alexei Barov. The follow-up The Last Barov sends you to kill the rival brother.

quests.name: Barov Family Fortune
quests.objective: Venture to the Scholomance and recover the Barov family fortune. Four deeds make up this fortune: The Deed to Caer Darrow; The Deed to Brill; The Deed to Tarren Mill; and The Deed to Southshore. Return to Weldon Barov when you have completed this task.
quests.description: The four deeds: Southshore in the first large chamber, Tarren Mill before the hatchlings, Brill by Ras Frostwhisper, Caer Darrow by Lord Alexei Barov. The follow-up The Last Barov sends you to kill the rival brother.

quests.name: Doctor Theolen Krastinov, the Butcher
quests.objective: Find Doctor Theolen Krastinov inside the Scholomance. Destroy him, then burn the Remains of Eva Sarkhoff and the Remains of Lucien Sarkhoff. Return to Eva Sarkhoff when the task is complete.

quests.name: Kirtonos the Herald
quests.objective: Return to the Scholomance with the Blood of Innocents. Find the porch and place the Blood of Innocents in the brazier. Kirtonos will come to feast upon your soul. Fight valiantly, do not give an inch! Destroy Kirtonos and return to Eva Sarkhoff.
quests.description: Use the Blood of Innocents at the brazier on the Scholomance porch. Rewards the Spectral Essence.

quests.name: The Human, Ras Frostwhisper
quests.objective: Travel to the Arathi Highlands, to the ruins of Stromgarde. Search Stromgarde for a Keepsake of Remembrance. If you find such an item, return with it to Magistrate Marduke.

quests.name: The Dying, Ras Frostwhisper
quests.objective: Travel to Light's Hope in Eastern Plaguelands and seek out Leonid Barthalomew the Revered. Show him the Keepsake of Remembrance and tell him all that you have discovered.

quests.name: Menethil's Gift
quests.objective: Travel to Stratholme and find Menethil's Gift. Place the Keepsake of Remembrance upon the unholy ground.
quests.description: After Baron Rivendare dies, use the glowing rune on the floor of his room, then take the follow-up back to Leonid.

quests.name: Menethil's Gift
quests.objective: Take the Soulbound Keepsake to Leonid Barthalomew in Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Soulbound Keepsake
quests.objective: Return to Magistrate Marduke in Caer Darrow. Show him the Soulbound Keepsake.

quests.name: The Lich, Ras Frostwhisper
quests.objective: Find Ras Frostwhisper in the Scholomance. When you have found him, use the Soulbound Keepsake on his undead visage. Should you succeed in reverting him to a mortal, strike him down and recover the Human Head of Ras Frostwhisper. Take the head back to Magistrate Marduke.
quests.description: Use the Soulbound Keepsake on Ras Frostwhisper to make him human, then kill him and bring back his human head.

quests.name: Krastinov's Bag of Horrors
quests.objective: Locate Jandice Barov in the Scholomance and destroy her. From her corpse recover Krastinov's Bag of Horrors. Return the bag to Eva Sarkhoff.
quests.description: The bag drops from Jandice Barov.

quests.name: Leonid Barthalomew
quests.objective: Bring the Frozen Eggs to Leonid Barthalomew in the Eastern Plaguelands.

quests.name: Plagued Hatchlings
quests.objective: Kill 20 Plagued Hatchlings, then return to Betina Bigglezink at the Light's Hope Chapel.
quests.description: Kill 20 Plagued Hatchlings. After turning this in, hatchlings can drop Healthy Dragon Scales, which start a repeatable turn-in to Betina.

quests.name: Betina Bigglezink
quests.objective: Bring the Frozen Eggs to Betina Bigglezink.

quests.name: Blessed Arcanite Barding
quests.objective: Return with the Blessed Arcanite Barding to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.

quests.name: The Divination Scryer
quests.objective: Bring an Azerothian Diamond and a Pristine Black Diamond to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.

quests.name: Judgment and Redemption
quests.objective: Use the Divination Scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement in the Scholomance. Doing so will bring forth the spirits you must judge. Defeating these spirits will summon forth Death Knight Darkreaver. Defeat him and reclaim the lost soul of the fallen charger. Give the Charger's Redeemed Soul and the Blessed Enchanted Barding to Darkreaver's Fallen Charger.
quests.description: Paladin charger quest. Clear Rattlegore's basement in the Great Ossuary, use the Divination Scryer and defeat the spirits and Death Knight Darkreaver.

quests.name: Material Assistance
quests.objective: If you are interested in helping Sagorne Crestrider in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom, bring him an Azerothian Diamond and a Pristine Black Diamond.

quests.name: The Darkreaver Menace
quests.objective: Use the Divination Scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement in the Scholomance. Doing so will bring forth spirits you must fight. Defeating these spirits will summon forth Death Knight Darkreaver; defeat him. Bring Darkreaver's Head to Sagorne Creststrider in the Valley of Wisdom, Orgrimmar.
quests.description: Shaman quest. Clear Rattlegore's basement, use the scryer and defeat Death Knight Darkreaver; return his head.
